findings.title: Supabase MCP linked to wrong org
findings.description: MCP lists only Insytix project (wogiywmqsluwqpacmeca) under Adwrks365; Nexestate project not accessible via MCP.
findings.evidence: list_projects returned 1 project; get_project(ynpdtbgmbunntckqmcaf) permission denied
findings.recommendedFix: Re-authenticate Supabase MCP with Nexestate org; supabase link CLI to ynpdtbgmbunntckqmcaf

findings.title: Vercel CLI on Adwrks team only
findings.description: vercel project ls shows adwrks projects; nexestate.co not visible. No .vercel/project.json locally.
findings.evidence: npx vercel whoami → adwrks; inspect nexestate.co failed
findings.recommendedFix: vercel login as Nexestate team; link project; document env var names

findings.title: GitHub active account is Adwrks365
findings.description: Acceptable: Adwrks365 has WRITE on Nexestate/NexEstate-v2. Cursor Adwrks 365 is intentional dev account.
findings.recommendedFix: Use gh auth switch if org policy requires Nexestate identity for pushes

findings.title: Google OAuth restored after Supabase unpause
findings.description: authorize endpoint now redirects (user confirmed; probe shows redirect not 502).
findings.recommendedFix: Monitor; document pause risk in runbook

findings.title: Local env missing VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
findings.description: .env.local has URL + service role only; client may not initialize Supabase locally.
findings.recommendedFix: Add anon/publishable key from Dashboard; never commit

findings.title: My Properties page uses demo data only
findings.description: Nav item 'נכסים שלי' shows DEMO_BROKER_LISTINGS, not Supabase listings.
findings.recommendedFix: Wire to fetchProperties / listings service like PropertiesPage

findings.title: Admin Users page is demo-only
findings.description: Admin user management displays DEMO_ADMIN_USERS.
findings.recommendedFix: Implement profiles admin service with RLS superadmin policies

findings.title: Admin Support page is demo-only
findings.description: Support tickets from DEMO_SUPPORT_TICKETS.
findings.recommendedFix: Add support_tickets table or integrate external helpdesk

findings.title: Admin Shares page is demo-only
findings.description: Property shares admin view uses DEMO_PROPERTY_SHARES.
findings.recommendedFix: Query property_shares + profiles join

findings.title: Admin Import is mock UI
findings.description: CSV upload simulates success; no backend import.
findings.recommendedFix: Use scripts/import-csv or Edge import with validation

findings.title: Buyer notifications demo data
findings.description: BuyerNotificationsPage uses DEMO_BUYER_NOTIFICATIONS state.
findings.recommendedFix: Reuse fetchNotifications like broker page

findings.title: Admin weekly activity chart is hardcoded
findings.description: WEEKLY_ACTIVITY constant array, not from DB.
findings.recommendedFix: Query profiles/properties created_at aggregates

findings.title: Sidebar payment count equals lease count
findings.description: paymentCount uses leaseByProperty not lease_payments count.
findings.recommendedFix: Count lease_payments or pending payments per property

findings.title: Lease payments may be empty in DB
findings.description: Import SQL has no lease_payments seeds; Payments page may be empty despite leases.
findings.recommendedFix: Idempotent SQL generator from active leases or UI to generate schedule

findings.title: Dashboard typography too small
findings.description: Widespread text-sm/text-xs in broker shell; users report small text.
findings.recommendedFix: Raise base dashboard type scale; optional settings toggle

findings.title: Property detail tabs navigate away
findings.description: Only overview inline; units/tenants/leases/payments link to separate routes.
findings.recommendedFix: Inline tab panels while keeping deep links

findings.title: Buyer search/favorites hidden from nav
findings.description: Routes exist but BUYER_NAV omits search and favorites.
findings.recommendedFix: Add nav items + mobile entries

findings.title: No global toast notification system
findings.description: Success/error feedback inconsistent across mutations.
findings.recommendedFix: Add Toast provider + use in services/mutations

findings.title: Large main JS bundle
findings.description: index bundle ~855KB minified; Vite warns >500KB.
findings.recommendedFix: Route-based code splitting; lazy load market/admin

findings.title: edgeFunctions dynamic/static import warning
findings.description: Vite cannot split edgeFunctions chunk due to mixed import styles.
findings.recommendedFix: Unify import style

findings.title: Missing meta description and OG tags
findings.description: index.html has title only; no description, og:image, canonical.
findings.recommendedFix: Per-route meta or react-helmet-async

findings.title: No sitemap/robots in repo
findings.description: No public/sitemap.xml or robots.txt found.
findings.recommendedFix: Add static or generated sitemap

findings.title: No client error monitoring
findings.description: No Sentry/LogRocket/etc. in codebase.
findings.recommendedFix: Add Sentry with env DSN; source maps on Vercel

findings.title: No product analytics
findings.description: No GA4/PostHog events for login, leads, shares.
findings.recommendedFix: Define event schema; add privacy-compliant analytics

findings.title: Zero automated tests
findings.description: No *.test.ts or *.spec.ts in repo.
findings.recommendedFix: Add Vitest for services + Playwright for auth smoke

findings.title: No npm lint script
findings.description: package.json has no lint command; ESLint not in audit pipeline.
findings.recommendedFix: Add eslint + lint script in CI

findings.title: RLS not re-verified post-restore
findings.description: Partner/shared access required multiple SQL fixes; full RLS audit not run via MCP.
findings.recommendedFix: Run Supabase advisors + manual partner/broker matrix test

findings.title: Service role key in local env only
findings.description: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in .env.local (gitignored). Ensure never in VITE_ vars.
findings.recommendedFix: Document; rotate if ever exposed

findings.title: Mobile viewport testing incomplete
findings.description: Authenticated mobile flows not browser-tested in this audit (no session).
findings.recommendedFix: Playwright mobile profiles for broker shell + tables

findings.title: Tables on mobile use card fallbacks inconsistently
findings.description: Some pages have md:hidden cards (Leases); others table-only.
findings.recommendedFix: Standardize responsive DataView component

findings.title: Payment Edge Functions deploy status unknown
findings.description: Four payment functions in repo; deployment not verified.
findings.recommendedFix: list_edge_functions on Nexestate project; deploy missing

findings.title: Landing marketing stats may be illustrative
findings.description: Hero stats (+10k properties, etc.) appear promotional; verify claims.
findings.recommendedFix: Replace with real metrics or label as examples

findings.title: AccessibilityContext not applied in dashboard
findings.description: Text scaling/high contrast mainly on public layout.
findings.recommendedFix: Extend tokens to dashboard or document scope

findings.title: Unused PlaceholderPage components
findings.description: PlaceholderPage not routed in App.tsx.
findings.recommendedFix: Remove or wire for future routes
